column1: # tests/coverage/unreachable.tsv - the markers of libhttpasm.so the tests do not run, each
# with its reason (tests/coverage/report.cs: the gate fails on a marker that did not run and is
# not listed here, and on an entry whose markers ran; docs/DESIGN.md section 2). One line per
# marker, tab-separated: file, kind (block, taken, fall), scope (the label scope: the function,
# usually), text (the labels or the jump; NASM's macro-local numbers as "..@."), reason. A
#   unreachable:  a proof that nothing reaches it, from the code (each caller's checks, an
#   rare:         reachable, under conditions no test provokes yet, named;
#   race:         taken only by a race (between threads, or the worker and the kernel's
#                 completions): exempt from going stale, it may run in any one run;
#   kernel:       reached on some kernels and not others (the gate runs on WSL's 5.15 and on
# Markers alike in key (two "jz .out" of one function) are a multiset: one line each, and all
# of a key's lines exempt or none. Started from report.cs --write-unreachable's draft.

unreachable: a recvfrom on a non-blocking TCP socket (MSG_DONTWAIT, or accept4's SOCK_NONBLOCK) never sleeps: tcp_recvmsg answers EAGAIN before it would wait (its timeout is 0), and EINTR comes only from an interrupted wait

unreachable: both callers handle a closed or zombie connection first: ha_set_interest (its own check, epoll) and uring_conn_work (.closed, io_uring)

unreachable: no epoll caller passes a closed or zombie connection: ha_conn_flush returns 1 right after it closes one and every caller stops there; ha_conn_process never closes; read_ready and the completions run only for open connections (worker_main skips closed ones; a deferred one that closed is a zombie, answered apart); io_uring tail-calls first

unreachable: every caller holds an open connection: those taking it from the deadline list (expire, close_idle, the forced stop), which a close unlinks it from; read_ready and worker_main's error event, which skip closed ones; the io_uring completions, which check C_CLOSED and C_ZOMBIE first; ha_conn_flush and handle_completions, on open ones
